thesis: A decent society distributes basic freedom broadly and brings responsibility near real power and capacity.

ideas.statement: Protect refusal, share care, support judgment and truthful work, make costs visible and evaluate remedies with affected people; ordinary decency should not require daily heroism.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: No policy equation or paradise follows; future interests do not license unlimited present sacrifice and indicators must not conceal tradeoffs in one score.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: No policy equation or paradise follows; future interests do not license unlimited present sacrifice and indicators must not conceal tradeoffs in one score.

audit.notes: All units read directly; glossary recurrence merged, documentary bibliography excluded.
